title: ticket template: extension (template_version 2)
description: Extend an EXISTING ticket's expiry. Default length 30 days (when new_expiry is not given). waiting_on fix (a fix is available): at most 2 extensions, each at most 90 days (EXTENSION_LIMIT_REACHED). waiting_on vendor: extensions continue until the vendor has a fix, and at the second extension or 180 days the developers are advised "no fix after 6 months, consider an alternative" (owner, 2026-11-04). The count is the ticket's own labels; extensions_used must equal it; the requester never approves it. KDEC-037.

ref.description: The ticket: a Jira numeric id or key, an Azure DevOps or GitHub number.

new_expiry.description: Optional: default today + 30 days; at most 90 days away.

extensions_used.description: How many extensions the ticket has had before this one.

receipt.description: A custody receipt for the evidence (a store's object id or signature).
